headline: Severe Fighting Rocks Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle Across Shifting Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, combat has surged dramatically in the north and west, with Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle seeing the heaviest territorial turnover along the line. Weathered Expanse remains in intense turmoil, recording ten base transitions and over four thousand casualties within the past two hours as battles swirl around Frostmarch, Wightwalk, and Crow's Nest. Stonecradle has accelerated into a major flashpoint, logging nine base events and thirty-two hundred casualties in two hours amid fierce fighting at Trammel Pool and The Heir's Knife. To the east, Stlican Shelf has broken its brief lull with three fresh transitions across The Old Mourn and Breaker Town, while Linn of Mercy recorded two further shifts. Island sectors have also stirred, with Godcrofts experiencing an influx of reinforcements and two base captures, and Fisherman's Row recording the turnover of Dankana Post. By contrast, active base changes have halted in Farranac Coast and Viper Pit over the last two hours, though Callahan's Passage continues to sustain severe attritional casualties despite static lines.
